purpose: Fresh paired evaluation of adaptive-sale quantity only, keeping CR008 forecast thresholds/products and append placement fixed.
quantity_rounding: ceil(stock * fraction), minimum 1 when a frozen CR008 trigger occurs
held_out_policy: All 32/32 held-out seeds remain sealed and forbidden.
selection_policy: Stage A may select at most one non-control arm. Candidate code, thresholds, products, placement, and selected fraction are then frozen for Stage B; no rescue tuning on Stage-A seeds.
